text:
maya: CI on main is red — several integration jobs failing during schema seed against nozzle-mock-db. error is 'connection reset by peer'. Started seeing spikes around 03:12 UTC. Anyone touch mock DB networking or rotation?
adrian: I noticed it too, failing in jenkins/integration/nozzle-job-4 with 502s from the mock. grabbing logs, pinging @ops-bot for any recent infra changes.
ops-bot: infra-bot: deploy/infra/ephemeral-net v2 applied at 03:05 UTC — enabled ip-rotation for ephemeral services (nozzle-mock-*).
liam: I merged infra PR #4127 yesterday to rotate mock IPs faster (lower TTL). Could be the culprit. I can revert but want to confirm first.
sasha: Can we rerun the failing jobs to check if transient? @ci-bot please rerun nozzle-integ-4 nozzle-integ-5.
ci-bot: ci-bot: jobs requeued: nozzle-integ-4 nozzle-integ-5 nozzle-integ-6 (retries=1).
rachel: Rerun failed with same error — logs show: ```ERROR: could not connect to 10.2.17.8:5432 — connection reset by peer
Stack: org.postgres.ConnectionException at connector/Connection.java:93```
adrian: That IP (10.2.17.8) looks like an old endpoint cached by the test harness. We changed DNS handling in the harness to cache IPs for 300s last quarter. Combined with rotation it can point to deallocated pod.
liam: Short term options: (1) pin mock to a stable ClusterIP for CI namespaces, (2) revert ip-rotation, or (3) update harness to resolve DNS on each connection. Which is fastest?
maya: I can patch the mock k8s Service to a static ClusterIP scoped to ci namespace. Doing it now.
ops-bot: infra-bot: applied patch to svc/nozzle-mock-db in namespace ci-nozzle; rolling restart of pods initiated.
liam: Thanks — ping me when pods are ready and I'll requeue the remaining matrix.
ops-bot: infra-bot: nozzle-mock-db pods restarted; all containers ready (3/3).
ci-bot: ci-bot: requeued jobs: nozzle-integ-4 nozzle-integ-5 nozzle-integ-6.
rachel: All green on reruns, 3/3 passed. :tada: Looks like IP rotation + harness caching was the trigger.
liam: Opening infra issue #4180 to revert ip-rotation and add an opt-in DNS-caching TTL flag for the harness. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/4181
maya: For now we'll keep the static ClusterIP in CI until patch lands. Closing this triage — marking incident=false. Thanks folks! :white_check_mark:
